mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods g JOIN inventory i ON i.goods_id = g.id WHERE g.status = 1
AND g.category_id = #{categoryId}

SELECT c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, NULL AS goodsId, NULL AS goodsCode, NULL AS goodsName, COUNT(i.goods_id) AS goodsCount, COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) AS stockQty, NULL AS costPrice, COALESCE(SUM(i.cost_amount), 0) AS costAmount, COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * g.retail_price), 0) AS retailValue, NULL AS stockStatus FROM goods g JOIN inventory i ON i.goods_id = g.id JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id WHERE g.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY costAmount DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods g LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.goods_id = g.id WHERE g.status = 1
AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= 0
AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower
AND g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper
AND (COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower OR (g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper))

SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.goods_code AS goodsCode, g.name AS goodsName, c.name AS categoryName, CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= 0 THEN 'OUT' WHEN COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'OVERSTOCK' END AS alertType, COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) AS stockQty, g.safety_stock_lower AS safetyStockLower, g.safety_stock_upper AS safetyStockUpper, CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower THEN g.safety_stock_lower - COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) WHEN g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) - g.safety_stock_upper ELSE 0 END AS gapQty, CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower THEN CEIL(g.safety_stock_lower * #{suggestK} - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ir.change_qty) / #{avgDays} FROM inventory_record ir WHERE ir.goods_id = g.id AND ir.record_type = 'SALE_OUT'
AND ir.business_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{avgDays} DAY), INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 0) * #{leadDays} - COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(poi.quantity - poi.received_qty) FROM purchase_order_item poi JOIN purchase_order po ON po.id = poi.order_id WHERE poi.goods_id = g.id AND po.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL')), 0)) ELSE NULL END AS suggestQty, i.last_change_time AS lastChangeTime FROM goods g LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id WHERE g.status = 1
AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= 0
AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower
AND g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper
AND (COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower OR (g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper))
ORDER BY gapQty DESC, g.id

SELECT ir.record_type AS recordType, COUNT(*) AS recordCount, COALESCE(SUM(ir.change_qty), 0) AS changeQty, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(ir.change_qty) * ir.unit_cost), 0) AS amount FROM inventory_record ir WHERE ir.business_date >= #{begin} AND ir.business_date <= #{end} GROUP BY ir.record_type ORDER BY ir.record_type

SELECT ir.goods_id AS goodsId, NULL AS goodsCode, NULL AS goodsName, NULL AS categoryId, NULL AS categoryName, NULL AS stockQty, NULL AS costAmount, NULL AS beginAmount, NULL AS avgAmount, NULL AS saleCostAmount, NULL AS returnCostAmount, COALESCE(SUM(ir.change_qty * ir.unit_cost), 0) AS flowAmount, NULL AS turnoverRate, NULL AS turnoverDays FROM inventory_record ir WHERE ir.business_date >= #{begin} AND ir.business_date <= #{end} GROUP BY ir.goods_id

SELECT soi.goods_id AS goodsId, NULL AS goodsCode, NULL AS goodsName, NULL AS categoryId, NULL AS categoryName, NULL AS stockQty, NULL AS costAmount, NULL AS beginAmount, NULL AS avgAmount, COALESCE(SUM(soi.cost_amount), 0) AS saleCostAmount, NULL AS returnCostAmount, NULL AS flowAmount, NULL AS turnoverRate, NULL AS turnoverDays FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = soi.order_id WHERE so.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} AND soi.goods_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY soi.goods_id

SELECT roi.goods_id AS goodsId, NULL AS goodsCode, NULL AS goodsName, NULL AS categoryId, NULL AS categoryName, NULL AS stockQty, NULL AS costAmount, NULL AS beginAmount, NULL AS avgAmount, NULL AS saleCostAmount, COALESCE(SUM(roi.cost_amount), 0) AS returnCostAmount, NULL AS flowAmount, NULL AS turnoverRate, NULL AS turnoverDays FROM return_order_item roi JOIN return_order ro ON ro.id = roi.return_id WHERE ro.business_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} AND roi.goods_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY roi.goods_id

SELECT l.goods_id AS goodsId, g.name AS goodsName, c.name AS categoryName, l.biz_type AS bizType, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS lossQty, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS lossAmount FROM loss_order l JOIN goods g ON g.id = l.goods_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id WHERE l.status = 'AUDITED' AND l.business_date >= #{begin} AND l.business_date <= #{end} GROUP BY l.goods_id, g.name, c.name, l.biz_type

SELECT sci.goods_id AS goodsId, g.name AS goodsName, c.name AS categoryName, 'CHECK' AS bizType, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(sci.diff_qty)), 0) AS lossQty, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(sci.diff_amount)), 0) AS lossAmount FROM stock_check_item sci JOIN stock_check_order sco ON sco.id = sci.order_id JOIN goods g ON g.id = sci.goods_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id WHERE sco.status = 'AUDITED' AND sci.diff_qty < 0 AND sco.business_date >= #{begin} AND sco.business_date <= #{end} GROUP BY sci.goods_id, g.name, c.name

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.cost_amount) FROM inventory i), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ir.change_qty * ir.unit_cost) FROM inventory_record ir WHERE ir.business_date >= #{begin} AND ir.business_date <= #{end}), 0)

SELECT ir.id AS id, ir.goods_id AS goodsId, g.goods_code AS goodsCode, g.name AS goodsName, ir.record_type AS recordType, ir.change_qty AS changeQty, ir.before_qty AS beforeQty, ir.after_qty AS afterQty, ir.unit_cost AS unitCost, ir.biz_type AS bizType, ir.biz_no AS bizNo, ir.operator_name AS operatorName, ir.operate_time AS operateTime, ir.remark AS remark FROM inventory_record ir JOIN goods g ON g.id = ir.goods_id WHERE ORDER BY ir.operate_time DESC, ir.id DESC

SELECT l.id AS id, l.order_no AS orderNo, 'LOSS' AS kind, l.goods_id AS goodsId, g.name AS goodsName, l.quantity AS qty, l.cost_price AS costPrice, l.amount AS amount, l.reason AS reason, l.apply_name AS applyName, l.auditor_name AS auditorName, l.audit_time AS bizTime FROM loss_order l JOIN goods g ON g.id = l.goods_id WHERE ORDER BY l.audit_time DESC, l.id DESC

SELECT sci.id AS id, sco.order_no AS orderNo, 'CHECK' AS kind, sci.goods_id AS goodsId, g.name AS goodsName, ABS(sci.diff_qty) AS qty, sci.cost_price AS costPrice, ABS(sci.diff_amount) AS amount, sci.diff_reason AS reason, sco.checker_name AS applyName, sco.auditor_name AS auditorName, sco.audit_time AS bizTime FROM stock_check_item sci JOIN stock_check_order sco ON sco.id = sci.order_id JOIN goods g ON g.id = sci.goods_id WHERE ORDER BY sco.audit_time DESC, sci.id DESC
